Team,

Heads up — during a spot check this morning our on-site handler found that two promo crates (Pallet IDs: FC-9921 / FC-9922) were incorrectly consolidated at the outbound yard and one box from FC-9922 is missing from the manifest. We need an urgent reroute for the missing box (contains 40 VIP kits) so those VIPs receive their kits for tomorrow's private reception. Options I see:
- Reconsign the missing box to the venue via same-day courier (if available)
- Pull together a partial air shipment for VIP kits from the warehouse and ship 2-day air
